extras: Requires external paid service (pay per row delivered).
intentEvidence: SpecStream is the live web data engine. One platform to build, search, extract, enrich, map, and monitor data across the entire web.
problem: Users need a way to pull real-time, structured data from the vast, unstructured live web directly into their notes.
summary: SpecStream is a live web data engine that extracts, enriches, and maps data from the live web into structured Markdown tables within Obsidian.
